# rms_email_configuration (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS Email Configuration for alert notifications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_email_configuration" "main" {
  company_id = 123456
  from_name  = "RMS Notifications"
  from_email = "notifications@example.com"
  smtp_host  = "smtp.example.com"
  smtp_port  = 587
  username   = "notifications@example.com"
  password   = "smtp_password_here"
  use_tls    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `host` (String) SMTP host name.
- `name` (String) Email name.
- `port` (Number) SMTP port number.

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password.
- `username` (String) SMTP username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the email configuration.
